goals: Add believable claimed-workplace activity while limiting Canary 1 resource-changing behavior to shepherd sheep shearing and fisherman fish catches.
Preserve output ownership and bounded storage without altering Matcha professions, trades, villager models, or vanilla global social behavior.
scope: Server-owned shepherd shearing of reachable adult regrown sheep, exact shear-output capture, and wool insertion only into face-adjacent barrels at the claimed loom.
Server-owned fisherman fish-only loot from a visible bounded cast/retrieve cycle, with output insertion only into the claimed job-site barrel.
Claimed-workstation look, hand swing, and restrained vanilla work sound for ten other professions; temporary shears/rod and an isolated fishing-float renderer.
Transient world-aware, owner-scoped path blocking for Sheep, Cow, Pig, Chicken, and Rabbit only while an active VWR task owns the physical open transition of a fence gate.

exclusions: Livestock slaughter, breeding, ranching, and simulated workstation economies.
Matcha behavior or resource-pack/model/texture/renderer changes to villagers; the fishing-float renderer is isolated to its own entity.
Global villager brain, social memory, schedule, trading, profession, or fence-gate changes; nearby item vacuum and nearest-container fallback.
Protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 profile access and unowned runtime deployment.

dependencies.reason: Exact game target and inspected sheep/villager/fishing APIs.
VWR directly consumes the installed private C27 Fisherman model and texture at runtime without copying their protected payload into its own artifact.
Required to submit the installed Ribbits C27 Geo model directly under VWR's Frog Villager pose.

state.milestone: The supplied C26 comparison screenshot is narrowly recorded as C26 runtime diagnostic evidence only: C25/C26's +2px folded-arm-local Y correction visibly moved the rod downward in the useful direction, while its +1px local Z correction moved in the wrong visual direction for the intended inward correction. C27 therefore retains +2px local Y and changes only final local Z to -2px, exactly -3px from the C25/C26 solid pose, while removing C26's cyan C24 ghost and comparison-only markers. No other rod, Fisherman productivity/deposit, Shepherd, or general runtime result is inferred. C27 is ACTIVE / STATIC_PASS / RUNTIME_UNTESTED.

exceptions.reason: VWR directly renders the installed private Ribbits C27 Fisherman model and texture without packaging their payload.
regression_evidence: Exact C20 runtime testing disproved parity between vanilla `translateToArms` and the active Frog Villager folded-arm hierarchy: the rod was high/displaced and its line detached toward an incorrect world point.
The private stack always installs Ribbits with VWR, so an intentional exact provider boundary is required.

current.summary: Keeps the C26-proven downward +2px local-Y correction and moves the solid rod three local Z pixels opposite C25, to final +2px Y / -2px Z, with only one physical-tip-lined rod.
